Container.Name: ZeroLeakage-Server
Container.Overview:
ZeroLeakage Server: a privacy-first network protector for every device on your LAN, plus encrypted DoH / DoT so phones and laptops stay protected on mobile data. AdGuard-style filter lists (OISD, HaGeZi, StevenBlack...), one-click blocked services (TikTok, YouTube, Roblox...), web categories, SafeSearch, schedules (bedtime, homework), local DNS records, filtering-bypass blocking, automatic client discovery and Guard: a local CrowdSec-style engine with threat-IP feeds, attack detection, bans/quarantine and a firewall blocklist export. All intelligence runs locally; nothing is reported anywhere. Optional multi-user sign-in syncs policy with the ZeroLeakage Windows and Android apps.
Give it its own IP (br0) so it can use port 53 and see each client's real address, then set your router's DNS server to that IP. Open the WebUI to create the admin account.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, downloaded lists and optional tls.crt / tls.key

Config.Name: Dashboard / API / DoH
Config.Description: Web dashboard, REST API and DoH over HTTP (use a TLS reverse proxy for remote access)

Config.Name: DNS-over-TLS
Config.Description: Android Private DNS / DoT (needs tls.crt + tls.key in /data)

Config.Name: HTTPS
Config.Description: DoH + dashboard over HTTPS (needs tls.crt + tls.key in /data)

Config.Name: Trust reverse proxy
Config.Description: true only if your own reverse proxy sets X-Forwarded-For

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for schedules and the query log
